neutral.EN: Someone died here. We should remember that.
neutral.TL: May namatay dito. Dapat nating alalahanin 'yon.

neutral.EN: Poor bastard. Didn't make it.
neutral.TL: Kawawa naman. Hindi nakaligtas.

neutral.EN: Another body in the dirt. World's unforgiving.
neutral.TL: Isa na namang bangkay sa lupa. Malupit ang mundo.

neutral.EN: They fought hard, by the looks of it.
neutral.TL: Lumaban nang husto, base sa hitsura.

neutral.EN: Someone lost a life here. Tread with respect.
neutral.TL: May nawalan ng buhay rito. Maglakad nang may galang.

neutral.EN: Looks like they got trapped. Rest easy.
neutral.TL: Mukhang naipit sila rito. Mamahinga ka na.

neutral.EN: Could've been any of us. Keep walking.
neutral.TL: Kahit sino sa atin pwedeng maging ganyan. Lakad na.

neutral.EN: Another survivor cut down too early.
neutral.TL: Isa na namang survivor ang pumanaw nang maaga.

neutral.EN: Body's cold. Let's make sure we don't end up like this.
neutral.TL: Malamig na ang bangkay. Siguruhin nating hindi tayo matutulad dito.

neutral.EN: Rest in peace, stranger. Let's keep moving.
neutral.TL: Sumalangit nawa ang kaluluwa mo. Magpatuloy tayo.

neutral.EN: Someone is going to answer for this.
neutral.TL: May mananagot para rito.

neutral.EN: They didn't deserve this. Whoever did it will pay.
neutral.TL: Hindi nila nararapat 'to. Pagbabayaran 'to ng may gawa.

neutral.EN: This wasn't rottens, this was murder. They'll bleed for it.
neutral.TL: Hindi 'to gawa ng infected, patayan 'to. Dudugo sila para rito.

neutral.EN: I'll find whoever did this and make them regret it.
neutral.TL: Hahanapin ko ang may gawa nito at pagsisisihan nila.

neutral.EN: They slaughtered them. There's no forgiving this.
neutral.TL: Pinaslang nila sila. Walang kapatawaran ito.

neutral.EN: Mark my words, retribution is coming for them.
neutral.TL: Tandaan mo, darating ang ganti para sa kanila.

neutral.EN: Whoever left this body won't walk away clean.
neutral.TL: Ang nag-iwan ng bangkay na 'to ay hindi makakatakas nang buo.

neutral.EN: Cold-blooded. I won't forget this sight.
neutral.TL: Walang awang pagpatay. Hindi ko makakalimutan ang nakita ko.

neutral.EN: Blood demands blood. We settle this score.
neutral.TL: Dugo ang kabayaran ng dugo. Tutuldukan natin 'to.

neutral.EN: They butchered one of our own. They will pay.
neutral.TL: Kinatay nila ang isa sa atin. Pagbabayaran nila.
